comparison.claim: This receipt reports one SparkCache-enabled observation and does not measure a cache-disabled baseline.

conditions.topology: four NVIDIA DGX Spark systems in a direct RoCE cycle

benchmark.source_snapshot_limitation: The exact benchmark source snapshot is not published, so reproduction is limited even though the measured working file is bound by SHA-256.

command: python llm_decode_bench.py --host http://<rank-0-address> --port 8015 --model glm-5.3-flash-nvfp4-dflash7-bf16-tp4 --concurrency 1,4,8 --contexts 16k --prefill-contexts 16k --prefill-duration 10 --max-tokens 512 --duration 30 --decode-warmup-seconds 3 --cell-warmup-timeout-seconds 180 --temperature 1.0 --token-targeting exact --display-mode plain --no-hw-monitor --isolated-server --unique-context-percent 100 --chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking":false}' --kv-budget 549950 --output ./benchmark-16k-run1.json

prefill.metric: prompt tokens divided by client time to first token

sustained_decode.metric: OpenAI continuous-usage completion tokens per covered measured window

excluded_cells.reason: capacity-limited; readiness warmup reached its timeout

limitations: This is one observation, with no repetitions or uncertainty estimate.
No A/B baseline was measured, so the receipt does not attribute throughput to SparkCache.
The command passed a chat-template setting, but the retained receipt did not record that field; this receipt does not claim the setting was applied.
C4 and C8 were capacity-limited and their throughput values are intentionally omitted.
The exact benchmark source snapshot is not published, so reproduction is limited.
